items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...It says Mineta there too on the end of the line. [INTERVIEWEE] I wonder what that was.

ctx.x: Now, you see, people in order to get the Excelsior Band, draw a crowd, they did sign up jobs with us sometimes from this year to the next year, you see. Take that same date on a big holiday or something like that. All the people that we'd play for regularly, you know, they'd sign up from one year to the other, you know, to get the Excelsior Band. Yeah. Because they know the Excelsior Band's on the crowd, you see. Right.

And here's some more organizations. I'll read a few of these since you say you have trouble reading them now. There's a boiler helpers company. That's one. Here's one I can't quite make up. It looks like demonstration of something for boys. It says Mineta there too on the end of the line.
I wonder what that was. If I could see you in my glasses.
